identity_boundary: The subject named So Hyon Jin in Treasury’s October 28, 2026 action. Similar names or historical roles in other publications do not establish identity, and no such identity link is asserted here.
caveats: The Treasury release and companion OFAC notice form one source family; they are not independent corroboration.
Administrative designation is distinct from a criminal charge or conviction. Conduct statements are Treasury assessments, not adjudicated criminal findings.
Roles and activity periods are retained only as reported on October 28, 2026; no current employment, control or whereabouts are inferred.
Only the Treasury press-release name is retained; no name-form mapping is asserted.
